name: Electric smelter · speed modules, tier three
collection: Long game flight plans and strategies
author: Autosaved (In-Out Electric Smelter, autosaved-f3d991e31c13c301); ports redesigned by Factorio Command Center

serviceInputs: Smeltable ore, stone, or iron plates
Power, robots, and items in the logistics network
serviceOutputs: Iron/copper plates, bricks, or steel, depending on the supplied ingredient
notes: 24 furnace/recycler entities choose their recipe from what you feed them. Their inputs and outputs are described separately from configured assembler recipes.

Feed iron ore or copper ore on one red belt at the west entrance (row 1, the second row) and supply electricity at any substation. Plates leave south on one yellow belt; ore the station does not use leaves east on the same row, so the next copy placed 30 tiles east takes it with no extra belts. One red belt feeds two copies at 900 plates per minute each.

Official 2.1.24 Space Age. Speed modules, tier three: 24 electric furnaces with 48 speed module 3s (2 in each furnace), fast inserters, red belts, red underground belts and red splitters, 4 substations, 2 roboports. Derived from the Autosaved "In-Out Electric Smelter" (autosaved-f3d991e31c13c301, https://autosaved.org/factorio/blueprints). WEST: ore in on one red belt, row 1 (second row). The station takes 1,800 ore per minute first; the rest leaves EAST on the same row, so copies placed 30 tiles apart chain along one ore line (one red belt feeds 1 copy). SOUTH: 1,800 plates per minute on one red belt in the last column. Iron or copper ore; a blocked plate exit or a full station never stops the ore line, and an unconnected east end does not stop the station. Supply electricity at any substation; copies placed side by side join one network.
Feed iron ore or copper ore, one kind per ore line. Each was tested on its own; mixed ore on one line was not tested.
Keep the splitter priorities: the entrance splitter sends ore to the station first (south output); the merge splitter sends plates to the exit column.
